battle.name: 第二次布匿戰爭
battle.brief: 公元前218年漢尼拔翻越阿爾卑斯山入侵義大利，前216年於坎尼以兩翼迂迴重創羅馬主力，前202年札瑪敗於西比阿，戰役延續至前201年和約。卡面的亞述長弓屬近東短複合反曲弓，並非本役制式裝備；同期羅馬用短弓、拋槍與投石手，迦太基則以西班牙弓兵、北非騎兵與數十頭戰象作戰。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 第二次布匿戰爭是公元前218年至公元前201年迦太基共和國與羅馬共和國之間長達二十三年的總戰爭，交戰地域橫跨伊比里亞半島、義大利半島、撒丁尼亞、西西里與北非沿岸。迦太基一方是西地中海航路的控制者，由百餘人組成的元老院與兩名執政官（suffete）主持決策，首都迦太基位於今突尼斯灣北岸；其陸軍以雇傭兵為主體，包含西班牙與高盧的輕裝步兵、伊庇魯斯與希臘的重裝兵、努米底亞與北非的騎兵，以及一支約三十頭戰象構成的衝撞部隊。統帥是巴卡家族的漢尼拔，其父哈米卡自公元前247年起在西班牙重建基地，弟哈斯德魯巴與馬戈分掌西班牙與義大利戰線；公元前215年迦太基更與馬其頓的菲力普五世訂立同盟，使希臘騎兵得以遠赴義大利。羅馬一方是拉丁城邦聯盟的領袖，採兩名執政官輪番統率、元老院居決策核心的體制，軍隊由公民徵召的羅馬軍團與意大利同盟分遣軍組成，軍團標準編制約五千人，分為三列重裝步兵、輕裝步兵與百人隊騎兵，並有專司投石與弓箭的盟友部隊。羅馬在西班牙、希臘與北非亦駐有分遣隊與行政長官，關鍵統帥包括西比阿·阿非利加努斯、法比烏斯·馬克西穆斯與馬爾凱盧斯。戰爭同時把西班牙各部族、努米底亞人、希臘城邦與馬其頓捲入長期的同盟與對抗之中。
countriesEn: The Second Punic War was a general war lasting twenty-three years between the Carthaginian Republic and the Roman Republic, from 218 to 201 BC, fought across the Iberian peninsula, the Italian peninsula, Sardinia, Sicily and the North African coast. Carthage was the mistress of the western Mediterranean sea lanes. It was governed by a senate of a hundred members and by two suffetes, and its capital stood on the north shore of the Gulf of Tunis. Its army was in substance a mercenary host: light infantry from Spain and Gaul, heavy infantry from Epirus and Greece, cavalry from Numidia and the African plains, together with a shock force of some thirty elephants. Command belonged to the Barcid family. Hannibal led the field armies, his father Hamilcar had rebuilt a base in Spain from 247 BC onward, and his brothers Hasdrubal and Mago held the Spanish and the Italian lines respectively. In 215 BC Carthage concluded an alliance with Philip V of Macedon, which allowed Greek cavalry to cross into Italy. Rome was the head of the Latin league, governed by two consuls in annual rotation with the senate as its directing centre. Its army combined Roman legions of citizen levy with contingents supplied by the Italian allies. A legion on the standard establishment numbered about five thousand men, formed of three lines of heavy infantry with light infantry and turmae of cavalry, supported by allied units skilled with the sling and the bow. Rome also kept detachments and provincial governors in Spain, Greece and North Africa, and its leading commanders were Scipio Africanus, Fabius Maximus and Marcellus. The war drew in the Iberian tribal states, the Numidians, the Greek poleis and Macedon as partners and adversaries on one side or the other.
people: 全役的核心人物是迦太基統帥漢尼拔·巴卡。公元前218年春，他率約二萬步兵與六千騎兵自西班牙越過埃布羅河，其後翻越庇里牛斯山與阿爾卑斯山。同年十二月，他在特雷比亞河擊敗執政官森普羅尼烏斯·格拉庫斯；公元前217年於特拉西梅內湖擊潰羅馬大軍；公元前216年於坎尼以雙翼迂迴重創羅馬主力，是歐洲史上以少勝多的最著名戰例。與他相對的是同族的哈米卡·巴卡，其父早於公元前229年攻取西班牙的軍城，公元前216年陣亡於埃布羅河畔；弟哈斯德魯巴·巴卡在西班牙抵擋西比阿兄弟，公元前207年率援軍越山進入義大利，於梅陶魯斯河戰役中陣亡；幼弟馬戈與元老院出身的哈斯德魯巴·吉斯柯先後在西班牙與非洲戰線作戰。羅馬方面的西比阿·阿非利加努斯由公元前218年提契努斯河受傷的執政官，轉為公元前208年奪巴埃庫拉、公元前206年勝伊利帕的西班牙統帥，再於公元前202年札瑪擊敗漢尼拔；法比烏斯·馬克西穆斯於公元前215年出任獨裁官，以拖延戰術替羅馬度過坎尼之後的危局；馬爾凱盧斯在卡西利努姆與塔蘭托的戰事中收復失地；努米底亞國王馬西那在關鍵時刻由迦太基轉投羅馬，率騎兵扭轉札瑪戰局。此外，執政官拉維尼烏斯於公元前215年在奧費斯河慘敗，是羅馬史上最嚴重的敗績之一；馬其頓的菲力普五世與安條克的君主亦以同盟與援助介入戰局。
peopleEn: The central figure of the whole war was the Carthaginian commander Hannibal Barca. In the spring of 218 BC he led some twenty thousand foot and six thousand horse out of Spain, crossed the Ebro, and then the Pyrenees and the Alps. In December of that year he defeated the consul Tiberius Sempronius Gracchus at the Trebia; in 217 he destroyed a Roman army at the lake of Trasimene; and in 216 BC at Cannae he mauled a Roman host with a double envelopment, the most celebrated case in European history of a smaller army defeating a larger one. Against him stood his own kin. His father Hamilcar Barca had taken the Spanish military capital as early as 229 BC and was killed by the Ebro in 216; his brother Hasdrubal Barca held the Scipios at bay in Spain, marched over the mountains with reinforcements in 207 and fell at the Metaurus; the younger brother Mago and the senator Hasdrubal Gisco served in turn on the Spanish and the African fronts. On the Roman side Publius Cornelius Scipio, later Africanus, began as the consul wounded at the Ticinus in 218, became the master of Baecula in 208 and of Ilipa in 206, and finally broke Hannibal at Zama in 202. Quintus Fabius Maximus, appointed dictator after Cannae in 215, saved Rome with the strategy of delay. Marcellus retook Casilinum and Tarentum. The Numidian king Masinissa changed sides at the decisive moment and turned the battle of Zama with his cavalry. The consul Lavinius, crushed at the Aufidus in 215, suffered the gravest Roman defeat in history, while the kings of Macedon and Antiochus entered the war by alliance and subsidy.
kits: 卡面的亞述長弓是亞述帝國時期的短複合反曲弓，弓臂以木片配角與筋製成，形制緊湊、張力大，屬於近東與北非長期延續的弓種，並非本次戰役羅馬或迦太基的制式裝備。真正出現在公元前218年至公元前201年戰場上的弓，大致分三類：羅馬軍團輔兵與意大利同盟軍所用的木角短弓，有效射程約一百五十至二百公尺；迦太基西班牙與北非雇傭兵使用的複合反曲弓；以及波利比烏斯記載在札瑪之戰中一半用希臘式弓、一半用斯基泰式角弓的迦太基弓兵。羅馬同時倚重巴利阿里投石手，以每千人至數千人的規模配屬各軍，其拋擲的石彈比弓矢更致命。冷兵器方面，羅馬步兵配鐵質短劍與每兵兩支、每支重約一公斤半的拋槍，配半圓大盾；迦太基與西班牙步兵多持西班牙彎刀與小圓盾。攻城裝備包括弩、投石機、撞柱與可移動攻城塔，羅馬在薩摩利亞與曼圖亞的圍城戰中曾實際運用。最大的技術差異在於象隊與馬車衝撞，這是希臘式與北非式兵器的結合，而羅馬最終靠密集的長矛步兵與繞側的騎兵取勝。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is a short composite recurve of the Assyrian type, its limbs built of wood strips bound with horn and sinew; compact and powerful, it belongs to a bow family that persisted for centuries in the Near East and North Africa, and it was not the standard weapon of either Rome or Carthage in this war. The bows actually present on the field between 218 and 201 BC fell into three groups: the short wooden and horn bows of the Roman auxiliary archers and of the Italian allies, with an effective range of roughly one hundred and fifty to two hundred metres; the composite recurve bows carried by Carthaginian mercenaries out of Spain and North Africa; and the bows of the Carthaginian archers at Zama, half of them Greek in pattern and half Scythian, as Polybius records. Rome relied above all on the Balearic slingers, attached to the armies in thousands, whose stone missiles were more lethal than arrows. Among the hand weapons, the Roman infantry carried an iron gladius, two pila each of about one and a half kilograms, and the large curved scutum; Carthaginian and Spanish troops carried the Spanish falcata and the small round caetra. Siege equipment included the ballista, the stone-thrower, the battering ram and movable siege towers, all of which Rome used at Samosata and at Mantua. The greatest technical difference lay in the elephant and the war chariot, a fusion of Greek and North African practice, and it was the dense spear infantry and the flanking horse of Rome that finally prevailed.
tactics: 漢尼拔的戰術核心是選地與包抄。公元前218年冬他以步兵縱隊渡特雷比亞河，先用騎兵擊潰羅馬騎兵掩護隊，再以迦太基騎兵兩翼包抄羅馬陣地，使格拉庫斯的羅馬軍在渡河後無法展開。坎尼之戰更完整：中央由迦太基主力與西班牙步兵接戰，兩翼騎兵先行擊破羅馬六千騎兵，緊接著迦太基縱隊不與中央合攏，而是沿羅馬縱隊兩翼向後迂迴，待羅馬縱隊因追擊而拉長陣形時完成合圍，羅馬軍被前後夾擊，這就是古代兵家所稱的坎尼包圍術。羅馬此後以三線縱隊作戰，前列以拋槍衝鋒後退入中列，兩翼由同盟軍的長矛兵與騎兵護住；關鍵的改變是拒絕再於開闊地與迦太基正面會戰，轉用法比烏斯的拖延戰術，以守土、斷糧、遊擊與反攻拖住漢尼拔，使其遠離迦太基的補給基地。西班牙戰線則相反，漢尼拔與哈斯德魯巴以夜襲、襲營與假攻擊分割敵軍，公元前211年他夜襲兩名執政官的營地，公元前207年奇襲哈斯德魯巴的營地奪取象群。札瑪之戰中，西比阿面對象群衝鋒，令步兵屈膝以矛刺入象鼻，並用套索絆倒象腿，待象群潰散後再以騎兵衝擊迦太基正面，最後由馬西那的努米底亞騎兵完成決定性一擊。圍城方面，羅馬以圍城塔、斜坡與填壕進逼城邑，並在牆下張設龜甲陣以護住工程人員。
tacticsEn: The core of the Hannibalic method was the choice of ground and the envelopment. In the winter of 218 he crossed the Trebia in a column, used his cavalry to break the Roman escort, then sent the Carthaginian horse round both flanks so that the consul Gracchus could not deploy after his crossing. Cannae shows the method complete: the Carthaginian centre engaged the Roman line while the cavalry first broke the six thousand Roman horsemen, and then the Carthaginian columns, refusing to close with the centre, wheeled along the flanks of the Roman formation and closed behind it, trapping a Roman army that had been drawn out in pursuit. The Romans thereafter fought in the triple line, the hastati casting their pila and falling back into the principes, with allied spears and cavalry guarding the wings. The real change was the refusal to meet Hannibal again in the open and the adoption of the Fabian delay, holding ground, cutting supplies, harrying and counterattacking so that Hannibal was drawn away from his base. In Spain the method was reversed: night attacks, assaults on camps and feigned movements divided the enemy, and in 211 BC Hannibal fell on the camp of the two consuls, while in 207 he surprised Hasdrubal camp and seized the elephants. At Zama, faced with the charge of the herd, Scipio ordered his infantry to kneel and thrust at the trunks and to trip the legs with nooses; when the elephants broke, the horse struck the Carthaginian front and the Numidian cavalry of Masinissa delivered the final blow. In siege warfare Rome advanced with towers, ramps and filled ditches, and worked covered formations up to the walls to shelter the engineers.
data: 兵力與損失的數字主要來自波利比烏斯與李維兩家的記載。漢尼拔公元前218年越嶺前約有步兵二萬、騎兵六千，越過阿爾卑斯山後折損慘重，抵達義大利時餘步兵約二萬六千、騎兵約八千，戰象約三十餘頭。坎尼之戰迦太基出動步兵約四萬、騎兵約一萬、象三十餘頭，羅馬方面則有步兵約八萬、騎兵約六千；羅馬軍的損失，波利比烏斯記為傷亡共約七萬、其中陣亡約五萬，李維則記陣亡四萬八千餘人，迦太基損失約五千七百人及八百匹馬。特雷比亞河之戰羅馬出動約二萬五千步兵與六千騎兵，陣亡逾二萬；特拉西梅內湖之戰羅馬三萬步兵與六千騎兵出發，僅約一萬五千人倖免；梅陶魯斯河之戰迦太基損失一萬二千餘人被俘，哈斯德魯巴陣亡。公元前202年札瑪之戰，羅馬有步兵約兩萬三千、騎兵約兩千四百，迦太基有步兵約三萬五千、騎兵約四千，羅馬傷亡約五千至一萬二千人，迦太基陣亡約兩萬、被俘約一萬。戰爭歷時二十三年，和約規定迦太基以白銀一萬塔蘭特分二十年償付。羅馬兵役制度方面，公元前214年元老院規定二十歲至四十六歲的公民須服滿十次戰役，兵源主要來自拉丁同盟與義大利盟邦的徵召。
dataEn: The figures for the war come mainly from Polybius and Livy. Before the mountains Hannibal had about twenty thousand foot and six thousand horse; after the crossing of the Alps he reached Italy with roughly twenty-six thousand foot, eight thousand horse and some thirty elephants. At Cannae Carthage put in the field about forty thousand foot, ten thousand horse and thirty-odd elephants, against about eighty thousand foot and six thousand horse for Rome. Polybius gives the Roman casualties at the battle as some seventy thousand in all, of whom about fifty thousand were killed, while Livy records forty-eight thousand two hundred dead; Carthage lost about five thousand seven hundred men and eight hundred horses. At the Trebia the Romans marched out with about twenty-five thousand foot and six thousand horse and lost more than twenty thousand. At Trasimene a Roman force of thirty thousand foot and six thousand horse marched out and barely fifteen thousand escaped. At the Metaurus Carthage lost more than twelve thousand prisoners and Hasdrubal fell. At Zama in 202 BC Rome had about twenty-three thousand foot and two thousand four hundred horse against some thirty-five thousand foot and four thousand horse, with Roman losses of five to twelve thousand and Carthaginian losses of about twenty thousand dead and ten thousand captured. The war lasted twenty-three years, and the treaty required Carthage to pay ten thousand silver talents over twenty years. On the Roman side the senate of 214 BC obliged citizens from twenty to forty-six years of age to serve ten campaigns, and the manpower came chiefly from the levy of Rome and of the Italian allies.
cause: 直接導火線是西班牙的權力分配。公元前227年羅馬與迦太基訂立條約，以埃布羅河為勢力分界，羅馬不許迦太基在河以南用兵；公元前218年羅馬執政官格奈烏斯·科爾奈利烏斯·西比阿為救援盟友薩貢托，率兵越過埃布羅河攻入條約所劃的迦太基勢力範圍，迦太基元老院在漢尼拔的推動下選擇應戰，漢尼拔遂率軍翻越庇里牛斯山，把戰火引向義大利本土。深層原因則是西地中海的商路爭奪：迦太基靠航運壟斷西班牙銀礦與北非農產的出口，羅馬則在迦太基於西西里戰爭後的廢墟上取利，自公元前228年起的西班牙戰爭中步步南進，兩者的邊界只剩埃布羅河一線。迦太基的決策亦受巴卡家族影響：哈米卡在西班牙重建的基地需要一個能翻越山嶺的取勝者，漢尼拔以西班牙的資源訓練出真正的兵團，繞開羅馬的海權，以陸路翻越阿爾卑斯山把戰爭帶到意大利。這是一場海國對抗陸國的戰爭，迦太基必須贏，羅馬輸了還能再來。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the division of authority in Spain. In 227 BC Rome and Carthage concluded a treaty that made the Ebro the line of partition and forbade Carthaginian troops to operate south of the river. In 218 the consul Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio, marching to relieve the Roman ally Saguntum, crossed the Ebro into what the treaty defined as Carthaginian territory, and the Carthaginian senate, pressed by Hannibal, chose to fight rather than to negotiate. Hannibal accordingly led his army over the Pyrenees and brought the war into Italy itself. Beneath the spark lay the contest for the western sea lanes: the export of Spanish silver and North African produce ran on Carthaginian shipping, while Rome had profited from the ruins Carthage left in Sicily and had been advancing steadily south in the Spanish war that began in 228 BC, until the frontier between the two powers was the Ebro alone. The Carthaginian decision was also shaped by the Barcid interest, for the base rebuilt by Hamilcar in Spain needed a commander able to cross mountains. Hannibal trained a real army on Spanish resources, avoided the Roman sea power, and marched over the Alps to carry the war to Italy. This was a war of a sea power against a land power: Carthage had to win, while Rome could afford to lose and come again.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了地中海的權力結構。羅馬雖在特雷比亞、特拉西梅內與坎尼三役損失慘重，卻以西比阿在西班牙的反攻和札瑪的勝利取得西班牙全境、北非據點與西地中海航路，迦太基則退回北非一隅。前201年和約之後，迦太基被剝去海外屬地並背負賠款，成為羅馬的附庸；公元前149年羅馬以迦太基撕毀條款為由再啟戰端，前146年迦太基城被攻毀，第三次布匿戰爭以羅馬的徹底勝利收場。戰術層面上，坎尼的包圍術成為西方兵學的教科書命題，從波利比烏斯到近代的毛澤東、拿破崙都曾反覆推演，漢尼拔在坎尼戰役中展現的機動與衝撞素質，在歐洲軍事教育中長期作為範本。制度層面上，羅馬在連續失敗後重整兵役、擴大同盟軍與城市常備警衛，公民徵兵制逐步讓位於職業化軍隊；對義大利的農業而言，戰爭帶來大批戰俘與被沒收的土地，貴族地主的土地集中加速，同盟城邦的忠誠也經過一次嚴酷考驗。戰爭同時把羅馬推向希臘世界：與馬其頓的同盟破裂後，羅馬介入馬其頓戰爭，前198年弗拉米尼努斯在阿普米尼亞斯獲勝並宣布希臘自由，希臘各城邦的命運從此與羅馬的擴張綁在一起。
impactEn: This war changed the balance of power in the Mediterranean. Rome lost terribly at the Trebia, at Trasimene and at Cannae, yet by the Spanish counterstroke of Scipio and the victory at Zama it took Spain, the North African positions and the western sea lanes, while Carthage was pushed back into a corner of Africa. After the peace of 201 BC Carthage was stripped of her overseas possessions and loaded with an indemnity, and became a client of Rome. Rome used the pretext of a breach of that treaty in 149 BC to open the third Punic War, and in 146 BC destroyed the city of Carthage. At the level of tactics the Cannae envelopment became a set piece in the western military canon, examined by Polybius and later by Mao and by Napoleon, and the qualities of movement and shock displayed at Cannae long served as a model in European military education. At the level of institutions Rome reorganised its recruiting after repeated defeats, widened its reliance on allied contingents and on a permanent guard of citizens, and the citizen levy gave way by degrees to a standing professional force. In Italy the war brought a flood of prisoners and confiscated land, accelerating the concentration of estates in the hands of the great families, while the loyalty of the allied communities was put to a severe test. The war also flung Rome into the Greek world: the alliance with Macedon collapsed, Rome intervened in the Macedonian War, Flamininus won at Amphipolis in 198 and proclaimed the freedom of Greece, and from then on the fate of the Greek cities was bound to Roman expansion.
result: 公元前202年10月的札瑪戰役決定了結局。漢尼拔的軍隊在布匿戰斯的兩翼崩潰，迦太基再無可用之兵，羅馬隨後在北非追擊殲滅殘部。公元前201年羅馬與迦太基訂立和約：迦太基放棄西班牙與北非的全部屬地，歸還自羅馬掠去的物品，賠付白銀一萬塔蘭特並分二十年清還，不得再越出本國疆界用兵。此後漢尼拔回到迦太基重整軍隊、推行改革，三年後被解除軍職並流亡，先後寄居敘利亞、安條克與比提尼亞，最終在這些流亡國家的庇護下自盡，終年約六十五歲。他的父親哈米卡、弟弟哈斯德魯巴與馬戈皆死於戰場或流亡途中，巴卡家族就此消亡，迦太基再也無法與羅馬抗衡。羅馬則自此確立西地中海霸權，隨後把注意力轉向馬其頓與希臘，並在半個世紀後藉第三次布匿戰爭徹底毀滅迦太基。第二次布匿戰爭的結束，並非一場戰役的勝負，而是迦太基海權帝國被羅馬陸權共和國取代的開始。
resultEn: The battle of Zama in October 202 BC settled the matter. The Carthaginian flanks gave way, Carthage had no further army to put in the field, and the Romans pursued the remnants into Africa. In 201 BC Rome and Carthage concluded a peace: Carthage gave up all her possessions in Spain and North Africa, returned what she had taken from Rome, paid ten thousand silver talents in twenty annual instalments, and was not to make war beyond her own frontier. Hannibal returned to Carthage, reorganised the army and carried through reforms, but was stripped of his command and exiled three years later. He stayed first in Syria, then at the court of Antiochus, and finally in Bithynia, and in the end took his own life in the refuge of those foreign kings, at about sixty-five years of age. His father Hamilcar, his brother Hasdrubal and Mago all died in battle or in exile, the Barcid house was extinguished, and Carthage could never again stand against Rome. Rome, on the other hand, assumed the hegemony of the western Mediterranean, turned its attention to Macedon and Greece, and half a century later used the third Punic War to destroy Carthage altogether. The end of the Second Punic War was not the outcome of a single battle, but the beginning of the replacement of the Carthaginian maritime empire by the Roman land republic.
